title: Understanding Fairness-Accuracy Trade-offs in Machine Learning Models: Does Promoting Fairness Undermine Performance?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures individual fairness in university admission decisions using a consistency metric.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith.
